subject: textures DELTA7 READY: texture views applied; test placement fix + host call pending
body:
Texture-view DELTA7 ready; render has applied the production patch. Current render_encoder.inc e007df1c088430bf72b88b110c5d940a076fb0e7210228d101edecf9aa053855 contains:
- newTextureViewWithPixelFormat: and textureType:levels:slices:.
- n2t_view_format_check aliases only; RGB/BGR, depth, size/block, LDR/HDR mismatch => nil.
- zero-copy view shares buffer/imported/shadow backing; copies mip/level/slice/layer metadata; retains source; CF-retains imported/shadow surfaces; importedHandleShared prevents double kernel release.
- ranged method only exact full type/levels/slices; subranges and 3D slices explicit nil.

Test fix needed for full host coverage: current render_encoder_host_test.inc 3f321fca has the test function after the host script's @class split and compound literals inside assert. Apply:
1) proposals/texture-view-tests-fix.patch (base 3f321fca..., patch 8a981a1e...)
2) proposals/texture-view-host-call.patch (base host_test_vs_texture.py 828d9047..., patch c4cbacbb...)
Then host_test_vs_texture runs test_texture_views early; render_frontend_host_test already calls it via test_render_commands.

Evidence: private overlay with patched frontend + fixed test compiled under ASan and emitted VIEW_TEST_PASS for valid sRGB alias, shared backing/metadata, source-outlives-view, invalid RGB/BGR/depth/size, exact range and wrong type/range nil. Full private overlay still hits the same late pre-existing RenderDescriptor teardown libobjc crash as unpatched baseline, so render's normal host suite is the final full pass. No hardware claim. No phone/native/publish/commit. Proposal README f2eca638...; implementation patch base 799feca5.../35456bd8..., clean test patch 5d89fd46....
